body:
Founder real-time (2026-08-28, same session as WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS' racer-first pivot): 'papercraft' -> named the pre-existing skateboard/NORTHSTAR.md scoping doc -> 'lets make a new one PAPERCRAFT' -> real new standalone repo created (founder set up the GitHub remote + LICENSE + SHANKPIT_CONSTRUCT.txt themselves, 'ill handle it' -> 'ok so you have the same assignment' -> 'do it again but this time from scratch scratch'). Fresh NORTHSTAR.md: 'Minecraft meets GTA3 plus Skate2' / 'Skyrim meets Cyberpunk', non-voxel (iterates SHANKPIT's own lineage, not GFD's voxel engine), single-node persistent + online-only, sandbox-first (not RPG-first, that's GFD's own identity), mods-first PARENA, SCENE_CITY as the real default spawn, no quests/no hard combat requirement to start, multi-tenant-MMORPG-portfolio and shared-currency-naming ('Flow') considerations flagged for later, talent-tree/map-editor/full-PARENA-toolchain vision named as real future direction. First real PARENA mod: PARENA/stdlib/papercraft/level_mod.prn -> packages/simulation/level_mod.c, real recursive I32 RPG level-for-XP decision logic, corrected to use the real construct XP curve (80 + (level-1)*35, SHANKPIT_CONSTRUCT.txt's own MatchProgression) per founder's own 'keep the experience gain from the construct' direction. Real Bazel build from day one, bazel test //... green. No server/client host code yet -- NORTHSTAR + one real verified mod only. PAPERCRAFT commits bff4238/5175170/4dc179b. PARENA commits 791f61a/f6b071b.

⚓ ☃
title: New repo: real NORTHSTAR + first real PARENA mod (RPG leveling, real construct XP curve)
